name: add_terraform_s3_lifecycle_rule
description: Add an S3 lifecycle rule (transition to STANDARD_IA + noncurrent-version expiration), proven by real terraform validate; broken leaves the rule status Disabled, which AWS ignores entirely
prompts: main.tf declares a bare aws_s3_bucket with no lifecycle management - old object versions and stale data accumulate (and cost) forever. Add an aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration resource, keyed off aws_s3_bucket.uploads.id, with ONE rule that: has status = "Enabled" (a rule with any other status is completely ignored by AWS, regardless of what else it configures), transitions objects to STANDARD_IA storage after 30 days, and expires noncurrent (old) object versions after `var.noncurrent_version_expiration_days` days - add that as a new number variable defaulting to 30. Run `terraform fmt`. Do not modify the existing aws_s3_bucket resource or the environment variable.

test_setup_files.check_lifecycle.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

fmt = subprocess.run(["terraform", "fmt", "-check", "-diff"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert fmt.returncode == 0, f"terraform fmt -check failed:\n{fmt.stdout}\n{fmt.stderr}"

init = subprocess.run(["terraform", "init", "-backend=false", "-input=false"],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f"terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}"

validate = subprocess.run(["terraform", "validate", "-no-color", "-json"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get("valid") is True, f"terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}"

content = open("main.tf", encoding="utf-8").read()

m = re.search(
    r'resource\s+"aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration"[^{]*\{(.*)\}\s*$',
    content, re.DOTALL)
assert m, "no aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration resource"
body = m.group(1)

status_m = re.search(r'status\s*=\s*"(\w+)"', body)
assert status_m, "lifecycle rule has no status"
assert status_m.group(1) == "Enabled", (
    f"lifecycle rule status is {status_m.group(1)!r} - a Disabled rule is ignored by AWS "
    f"entirely, so old object versions never actually expire despite the configuration "
    f"looking complete")

assert re.search(r"noncurrent_version_expiration\s*\{", body), (
    "no noncurrent_version_expiration block")
assert re.search(r"noncurrent_days\s*=", body), "noncurrent_version_expiration missing noncurrent_days"

assert re.search(r"transition\s*\{", body), "no transition block"
assert re.search(r'storage_class\s*=\s*"STANDARD_IA"', body), "transition storage_class missing"

# the original bucket resource must survive untouched
assert re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_s3_bucket"\s+"uploads"\s*\{', content), "bucket resource lost"

print("PASS terraform lifecycle-rule checks")
